about-section.title: About me
about-section.p1: I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and a Post-grad in Software Architecture. Currently, I am studying Electrical Engineering to deepen my foundation in exact sciences and computing.
about-section.p2: I seek to validate my studies in practice. I have experience developing commercial systems from scratch, working through the full cycle from design to deploy.
about-section.p3: I don't stick to a single stack; I believe in choosing the right tool for each challenge. Regardless of the language, my focus is always on code quality and structure.
